A few things to know.

How do Academy and PoolForge fit together?

The Academy is your learning space. PoolForge is the market workspace. This portal gives you a clear route to both; access is determined by your account membership.

Where do I sign in?

Use your existing Academy sign-in for lessons. PoolForge currently uses its own account. Launch PoolForge to open its sign-in screen.

Are results guaranteed?

No. Lessons support informed decision-making, and market signals can lose. Understand the risk and use a plan you can afford.
